name: AL PoC: LLM telemetry harvester (tokens per call)

nodes.name: EveryMinute
nodes.notes: PoC path for per-call LLM telemetry. Production: OpenTelemetry export from n8n carries the same llm.tokens.* attributes to the APM.

nodes.name: ListRecentExecutions
nodes.notes: Metadata only, no execution data. Never pull data in bulk: 100 full executions in one call OOM-killed the lab instance.

parameters.query: select distinct execution_id from al_poc.step_log where step = 'llm_call' and execution_id = any(string_to_array($1, ','));

nodes.name: FetchExecution
nodes.notes: One execution at a time, with data. At most 10 per minute.

nodes.name: InsertLlmCalls

parameters.query:
with r as (select * from jsonb_to_recordset($1::jsonb) as x(order_id text, execution_id text, workflow_id text, node text, run_index int, agent text,
            tokens_in int, tokens_out int, duration_ms int, at timestamptz)),
ins as (
  insert into al_poc.step_log (order_id, execution_id, step, agent, message, detail, tokens_in, tokens_out, duration_ms, at)
  select case when o.order_id is null or coalesce(r.at, now()) >= o.started_at - interval '2 minutes' then r.order_id end,
         r.execution_id, 'llm_call', r.agent, r.node || ' run ' || r.run_index || ': ' || (r.tokens_in + r.tokens_out) || ' tokens',
         jsonb_build_object('node', r.node, 'run_index', r.run_index, 'workflow_id', r.workflow_id), r.tokens_in, r.tokens_out, r.duration_ms, coalesce(r.at, now())
  from r left join al_poc.order_intake o on o.order_id = r.order_id
  on conflict (execution_id, (detail->>'node'), (detail->>'run_index')) where step = 'llm_call' do nothing
  returning id
)
select $2 as execution_id, (select count(*) from r)::int as seen, (select count(*) from ins)::int as inserted;

nodes.notes: Calls from an earlier run of the same order id (a re-sent lab fixture) are kept for the execution marker but detached from the order.

parameters.content:
## LLM telemetry harvester

Every minute: list the last 30 executions (metadata only), keep the finished ones of the intake and the two agents that have no llm_call rows yet, fetch those one at a time with run data (at most 10), and insert one step_log row per model call (tokens in/out, duration), idempotent per execution, node and run. The dashboard sums them per order. Never pull execution data in bulk: 100 full executions in one call OOM-killed the lab. Production: the same llm.tokens.* attributes leave n8n over OpenTelemetry; this workflow is the PoC and chargeback path.
